---
title: "Visualizing Population Proportion of Two Groups"
author: "Anthony Morciglio"
date: "11/20/2025"
output: html_document
---

```{r, echo=TRUE, message=FALSE}

# ------------------------------
# 1. Simulate Two Proportion Groups
# ------------------------------

# Example manufacturing scenario:
# Old machine: 28 defects out of 500
# New machine: 12 defects out of 450

n1 <- 500
x1 <- 28
p1 <- x1 / n1

n2 <- 450
x2 <- 12
p2 <- x2 / n2

# Standard errors for each group's proportion
se1 <- sqrt(p1 * (1 - p1) / n1)
se2 <- sqrt(p2 * (1 - p2) / n2)

# Put into a data frame
df <- data.frame(
  Group = c("Manufactured Component 1", "Manufactured Component 2"),
  Proportion = c(p1, p2),
  SE = c(se1, se2),
  Upper = c(p1 + 1.96 * se1,  p2 + 1.96 * se2),
  Lower = c(p1 - 1.96 * se1,  p2 - 1.96 * se2)
)

df

# ------------------------------
# 2. Plot With Error Bars and Central Tendencies
# ------------------------------

library(ggplot2)

# Compute overlap region between confidence intervals
overlap_lower <- max(df$Lower)
overlap_upper <- min(df$Upper)
overlap_exists <- overlap_lower < overlap_upper

# Create a shaded overlap data frame (if overlap exists)
if (overlap_exists) {
  overlap_df <- data.frame(
    x = c(0.5, 2.5),
    y_min = overlap_lower,
    y_max = overlap_upper
  )
}

# Plot
ggplot(df, aes(x = Group, y = Proportion)) +
  
  # Shaded overlap region
  { if (overlap_exists)
      geom_rect(data = overlap_df,
                aes(xmin = 0.5, xmax = 2.5,
                    ymin = y_min, ymax = y_max),
                inherit.aes = FALSE,
                alpha = 0.2, fill = "lightblue")
  } +
  
  # Error bars
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = Lower, ymax = Upper), width = 0.15, size = 1) +
  
  # Point estimates
  geom_point(size = 4, color = "blue") +
  
  # Labels and theme
  labs(
    title = "Proportion Comparison With Error Bars",
    subtitle = "Showing Central Tendencies and Overlap Between Groups",
    y = "Proportion Defective",
    x = "Group"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 16)

```
